standard_prerequisites.name: Pullback preserves m-pseudo-coherence, by the cohomology pseudo-coherent pullback lemma
An fpqc covering of an affine open can be refined by finitely many affine opens of the members mapping into it, so the converse reduces to a single surjective flat morphism of affine schemes
standard_prerequisites.use: Sets up the affine descent situation.

standard_prerequisites.name: Over a ring, m-pseudo-coherence descends along faithfully flat ring maps, by the More on Algebra flat descent lemma, applied through the affine comparison and the pseudo-coherent affine lemmas

core_obligations: Forward direction: pullback preserves m-pseudo-coherence by the cohomology pullback lemma, so each Lf_i^*E is m-pseudo-coherent whenever E is (proof lines 3053-3054).

Reduction: let U be affine open of X; it suffices to show E|_U is m-pseudo-coherent; refine the fpqc covering by finitely many affine opens V_j of members with f_{a(j)}(V_j) subset U covering U, replace the covering by the single surjective flat morphism from the disjoint union V = coprod V_j, and reduce to X and Y affine (proof lines 3055-3063).

Conclude: over the affine ring the statement becomes descent of m-pseudo-coherence of module complexes along a faithfully flat ring map, which is the More on Algebra flat descent lemma, reached through the affine comparison and pseudo-coherent affine lemmas (proof lines 3064-3067).
proof_roadmap: Forward direction by pullback preservation (proof lines 3053-3054).
Refine the covering and reduce to one flat morphism of affines (proof lines 3055-3063).
Conclude by module-level flat descent (proof lines 3064-3067).
